Endpoint: Cardiovascular disease FUNCTION

```{r}
endpoint_cox_model <- function(disease) {
  #read in data
  disease_ep <- df_endpoints %>%
    dplyr::filter(ENDPOINT == disease) %>% 
    dplyr::right_join(df_pheno, by = "FINNGENID") %>%
    rename(STATUS = CONTROL_CASE_EXCL) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(SEX = as.factor(SEX)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(allele2 = dplyr::case_when(allele == "REFERENCE" ~ "REFERENCE",TRUE ~ "CARRIERS") %>%
    factor(levels = c("REFERENCE", "CARRIERS")))

#Cox model
surv_object <- Surv(time = disease_ep$AGE, event = disease_ep$STATUS)

fit.coxph_all <- coxph(surv_object ~ allele + SEX + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + PC6 + PC7 + PC8 + PC9 + PC10, data = disease_ep)

fit.coxph_2 <- coxph(surv_object ~ allele2 + SEX + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + PC6 + PC7 + PC8 + PC9 + PC10, data = disease_ep)
#return a list containing df and cox
return(list(df = disease_ep,
            cox = fit.coxph_all,
            cox2 = fit.coxph_2))
}

extract_cox <- function(fit, disease, allele_rows) {

  summ <- summary(fit)
  coefs <- summ$coefficients
  ci <- summ$conf.int

  # keep only allele rows
  keep <- rownames(coefs) %in% allele_rows
  coefs <- coefs[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  ci <- ci[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  tibble::tibble(
    disease  = disease,
    genotype = rownames(coefs),
    HR       = ci[, "exp(coef)"],
    lower95  = ci[, "lower .95"],
    upper95  = ci[, "upper .95"],
    p        = coefs[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  )
}
```

```{r}
#c_endpoints is the list of endpoints
results <- lapply(c_endpoints, function(d) {

  fit <- endpoint_cox_model(d)

  # allele model (3-level  2 rows)
  df1 <- extract_cox(
    fit = fit$cox,
    disease = d,
    allele_rows = c("alleleHOMOZYGOUS", "alleleHETEROZYGOUS")
  )

  # allele2 model (REFERENCE vs CARRIER  1 row)
  df2 <- extract_cox(
    fit = fit$cox2,
    disease = d,
    allele_rows = c("allele2CARRIERS")
  )

  dplyr::bind_rows(df1, df2)
})

#Final output
final_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(results)
```

Cumulative incidence plots

```{r}
endpoint_survfit <- function(disease) {
  #read in data
  disease_ep <- df_endpoints %>%
    dplyr::filter(ENDPOINT == disease) %>% 
    dplyr::right_join(df_pheno, by = "FINNGENID") %>%
    rename(STATUS = CONTROL_CASE_EXCL) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(SEX = as.factor(SEX)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(allele2, PC1:PC10)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  #surfit
  fits <- survfit(Surv(AGE, STATUS) ~ allele, data = disease_ep)

return(list(
  data = disease_ep,
  fits = fits
))
}

title_list <- c(
  "Hypertension",
  "Cardiovascular disease",
  #"Myocardial infarction",
  #"Stroke",
  #"Orthostatic hypotension",
  #"Parkinson's disease",
  #"Atrial fibrillation",
  #"Chronic kidney disease",
  "Venous thromboembolism"
)

#running a list of survfit
results <- lapply(c_endpoints, endpoint_survfit)
names(results) <- c_endpoints
```

```{r}
#plotting the list
plot_endpoint <- function(res, title) {
  ggsurvplot(
    fit = res$fits,
    data = res$data,
    fun = "event",
    risk.table = FALSE,
    censor = FALSE,
    ggtheme = theme_classic(base_size = 14),
    legend.title = "Genotype",
    legend.labs = levels(res$data$allele),
    pval = TRUE,
    pval.coord = c(25, 0.3),
    pval.size = 5,
    xlim = c(20,80),
    #ylim = c(0.3, 1.0),
    title = title,
    palette = c(
        "REFERENCE"     = "gold",
        "HETEROZYGOUS"  = "#A6CEE3",
        "HOMOZYGOUS"    = "darkblue"
      )
  )
}

#get a list of survplots
plots <- mapply(
  FUN = plot_endpoint,
  res = results,
  title = title_list,
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE
)

#extract xplot for plotting
plotlist <- lapply(plots, function(x) x$plot)

#removes axis title to get one shared one
plotlist <- lapply(plotlist, function(p) {
  p + theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )
})

grid <- ggarrange(
  plotlist = plotlist,
  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 3,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "bottom"
)

y_titles <- ggarrange(
  text_grob("CI", rot = 90, size = 14),
  text_grob("CI", rot = 90, size = 14),
  text_grob("CI", rot = 90, size = 14),
  ncol = 1
)

x_titles <- ggarrange(
  text_grob("Age", size = 14),
  text_grob("Age", size = 14),
  text_grob("Age", size = 14),
  ncol = 3
)

#to get shared y axis
final_plot <- ggarrange(
  y_titles,      # left column of y-axis titles
  grid,          # main 3×3 grid
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(0.1, 1)
)

#to get shared x axis
final_plot <- ggarrange(
  final_plot,
  x_titles,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 0.05)
)

final_plot
```

Drug purchase - time to first drug purchase

```{r}
process_medication <- function(atc_code) {
  
  labs <- df_medpurch %>%
  dplyr::filter(MEDICATION_ATC == atc_code) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(FINNGENID) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(MEDICATION_AGE, .by_group = TRUE) %>% #sort by EVENT_AGE within each group
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(MEDS = 1) %>%
  ungroup()
  
  # Filter, join, clean
  drug <- labs %>%
    dplyr::right_join(df_pheno, by="FINNGENID") %>%
    tidyr::replace_na(list(MEDS = 0)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(MEDS = as.numeric(MEDS),
                  AGE = dplyr::if_else(
                                    MEDS == 0, AGE_AT_DEATH_OR_END_OF_FOLLOWUP, MEDICATION_AGE),
                  AGE = as.numeric(AGE),
                  SEX = as.factor(SEX)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(MEDICATION_AGE, AGE_AT_DEATH_OR_END_OF_FOLLOWUP))
    
    
  # cox model
  surv_object <- Surv(time = drug$AGE, event = drug$MEDS)

  fit.coxph_all <- coxph(surv_object ~ allele + SEX + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + PC6 + PC7 + PC8 + PC9 + PC10, data = drug)
  
  fit.coxph_2 <- coxph(surv_object ~ allele2 + SEX + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + PC6 + PC7 + PC8 + PC9 + PC10, data = drug)
#return a list containing df and cox
return(list(df = drug,
            cox = fit.coxph_all,
            cox2 = fit.coxph_2))
}

extract_cox <- function(fit, drug, allele_rows) {

  summ <- summary(fit)
  coefs <- summ$coefficients
  ci <- summ$conf.int

  # keep only allele rows
  keep <- rownames(coefs) %in% allele_rows
  coefs <- coefs[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  ci <- ci[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  tibble::tibble(
    atc_code = drug,
    genotype = rownames(coefs),
    HR       = ci[, "exp(coef)"],
    lower95  = ci[, "lower .95"],
    upper95  = ci[, "upper .95"],
    p        = coefs[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  )
}


med_count <- c("C03AA", "C09A", "C09C", "C07A", "C08CA")
```

```{r}
#c_endpoints is the list of endpoints
results <- lapply(med_count, function(d) {

  fit <- process_medication(d)

  # allele model (3-level  2 rows)
  df1 <- extract_cox(
    fit = fit$cox,
    drug = d,
    allele_rows = c("alleleHOMOZYGOUS", "alleleHETEROZYGOUS")
  )

  # allele2 model (REFERENCE vs CARRIER  1 row)
  df2 <- extract_cox(
    fit = fit$cox2,
    drug = d,
    allele_rows = c("allele2CARRIERS")
  )

  dplyr::bind_rows(df1, df2)
})

#Final output
final_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(results)
```
